name: The Homecoming

outcomes.description: With these reflections he entered his carriage and returned home.

stages.description: M. de Villefort was not only a magistrate, he was almost a diplomatist.

objectives.text: Bring the Pharaon to her mooring.

stages.description: In a very few minutes the count reached No. 7 in the Rue Meslay.

objectives.text: Give the owner the voyage, plainly.

stages.description: I have evinced?—none whatever. What granted me?—scarcely more.

objectives.text: See M. Morrel about the captaincy.

summary: The Pharaon is home and her captain is not.
